records.title: Add browser remote access
records.body:
## Summary

- Add a token-authenticated HTTP/WebSocket remote server in the Tauri backend so the desktop app can be controlled over the network
- Introduce a web bridge layer (`src/bridge/*`) that lets the existing UI run in a browser when connected remotely
- Add Settings UI to enable/disable remote access, manage the access token, and copy connection URLs

## Test plan

- [ ] Build and run the desktop app locally
- [ ] Enable remote access in Settings and verify a token + URL are shown
- [ ] Open the remote URL in a browser with the token and confirm the UI loads
- [ ] Exercise core flows over remote (PTY, invoke commands, events) and confirm blocked window-only commands stay unavailable
- [ ] Disable remote access and confirm the server stops and browser sessions disconnect
